// Generated by NeoHouse from "snapshot"
// 7 notes, 7001 ticks (350.05s)
function tune() {
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HARP", 0.7, 0.5, INVOKER);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS", 0.7, 0.5946, INVOKER);
    pause(4);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HARP", 0.7, 0.7071, INVOKER);
    pause(6);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HARP", 0.7, 1.0, INVOKER);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS", 0.7, 0.8409, INVOKER);
    pause(190);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS", 0.7, 1.1892, INVOKER);
    pause(6000);
    pause(800);
    playSound("BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HARP", 0.7, 1.4142, INVOKER);
}
